nodes.label: Sync Status Model
nodes.source_file: docs/archive/prompts/used/phase5 - Prompt 5A: Define offline and sync status model.md
nodes.rationale: Domain model defined before any sync behavior so collection, wishlist, metadata cache, and future sync actions share one vocabulary; values: Local only, Synced, Pending, Failed, Conflict (if useful), Offline.

nodes.label: Local-First Principle
nodes.source_file: docs/archive/prompts/used/phase5 - Prompt 5A: Define offline and sync status model.md
nodes.rationale: Phase 5 design intent: collection list, collection detail, and wishlist must each work with no internet and no Discogs token, reading from local storage only and never calling the Discogs API; caches and sync status are layered on top rather than making the API a dependency.
